description: Defines the ClassList class which manages a collection of class instances, allowing addition, retrieval, and management of classes within a buffer, including finalization and swapping operations.

classes.name: ClassList
classes.description: Manages a list of class instances, providing methods to add, retrieve, and manipulate classes within a buffer.

methods.name: addClass
methods.description: Adds a new class of type T to the ClassList buffer, finalizing the previous class if necessary, and returns a shared pointer to the new class.

methods.name: getClass
methods.description: Retrieves the first class of type T.

methods.name: getClass(size_t idx)
methods.description: Retrieves the class of type T at the specified index among classes of that type.

methods.name: getClassList
methods.description: Returns a list of all classes of type T.

methods.name: prevClass
methods.description: Returns a shared pointer to the last added class.

methods.name: getMessageBuffLength
methods.description: Returns the length of the message buffer.

methods.name: getMessageBuff
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the message buffer.

methods.name: swap
methods.description: Swaps the byte order or internal state as needed.

methods.name: finalize
methods.description: Finalizes the class list, performing necessary conversions and checks.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the class list, optionally enabling parsing.
